en.idx.0265: Among institutions of higher learning, Heydar Aliyev showed special concern for BSU, Azerbaijan's first European-type institution of higher education, which played an exceptional role in the development of Azerbaijan's science, education, and culture. In the opinion of the National Leader, the teachers working in the University's lecture halls and departments were playing an exceptional role in developing the identity, national consciousness, and national spirit of the Azerbaijani people. Heydar Aliyev paid special attention to the Azerbaijani teacher and the appreciation of his work. Precisely during his leadership of the republic, the teacher came to be regarded as the most respected and influential profession in Azerbaijan. The National Leader valued a true intellectual highly: 'What characterizes an intellectual in the first place? A higher education diploma? A doctorate diploma? I think not. The main quality of an intellectual is to serve society with dedication...'
en.idx.0266: Heydar Aliyev noted that Azerbaijan's modern development was possible on the basis of this educational institution's achievements. He could not imagine Azerbaijan's history, culture, science, and economy, the entire modern Azerbaijani society apart from this temple of science. He saw Azerbaijan's future in the University, made every effort to create all necessary conditions for training the new generation, and believed that the country's development could be achieved with the help of this educational institution. The National Leader approached this matter as a priority direction of state policy. Therefore, the University was always at the center of attention given to education.
en.idx.0267: As a result of this concern, long after the initiative to commemorate the 10th anniversary, finally on November 1, 1969, the University's 50th anniversary was celebrated at the state level. The participation of the country's leader Heydar Aliyev in the anniversary event held at the F.E. Dzerzhinsky Club (the present Shahryar Club) and his speech in the native language marked a turning point in awakening the national spirit not only for the University collective but for the entire Azerbaijani society. This speech lit a flame of hope in the heart of the University collective suffering from the repressions and persecutions of the totalitarian Soviet regime, laying the foundation for a new qualitative stage in the University's life.
en.idx.0268: In his speech highlighting Heydar Aliyev's emphasis on the magnificent and effective role of the University in the life of the Azerbaijani people, the development of Azerbaijani science, and the rise of our economy, he stated: 'The jubilee of the first institution of higher learning in Azerbaijani territory is such an event that its social significance extends far beyond Azerbaijan's state boundaries. The participation of representatives of Moscow's and Leningrad's science and education centers in the jubilee celebrations is evidence of this opinion. Allow me, on behalf of the Azerbaijani people, to sincerely welcome all participants of this solemn gathering dedicated to the 50th anniversary of Azerbaijan State University. And I express my gratitude to them. Today, on this solemn jubilee day, we respectfully remember those who devoted their knowledge and talents to the creation and development of Azerbaijan University. We honor and gratefully recall the names of prominent scholars and social figures V.I. Razumovsky, T. Shahbazi, I.I. Shirokogorov, Y.B. Lopukhin, A. Haqverdiyev, R. Malikov, H. Shahtakhtinski, J. Nagiyev, H. Rzabayov, B. Hasanbayov, A. Qarayev, Y. Mammadaliyev, M. Alakbarli and many other famous figures. Their lives and creative activities are inseparably connected with the history of Azerbaijan University. Venerable scholars, veterans of Azerbaijan State University, those who received the relay of scientific honor from the University's founders have gathered here. Allow me to sincerely congratulate them on the glorious jubilee of Azerbaijan State University and wish them strong health, happiness, and new creative achievements. I welcome all professors and teachers of Azerbaijan University who have dedicated their strength and knowledge to the noble task of preparing young specialists. I also cordially welcome all the achievements of Azerbaijan University, all its students, and in their persons all our promising youth, worthy successors of a great cause.' The political figure, valuing the University's historical service highly, compared it to a mighty tree, calling other universities its branches. In his speech, characterizing the period when the university opening was discussed in Azerbaijani public circles in 1919, he noted: 'Some expressed doubt, saying this work would not succeed, it would be better to send young people to study at renowned university centers in foreign countries. Today we can tell those skeptics that envoys from four continents come to Azerbaijan to study. Young people from 27 foreign countries of the world study in Azerbaijani higher education institutions. Another aspect of the historical service of Azerbaijan University is that it has prepared a large cadre of highly qualified specialists for Azerbaijan's national economy, science, and culture.' Emphasizing that Baku University was founded during difficult days of the Azerbaijani people's life, Heydar Aliyev boldly stressed that the circumstances existing at that time could not prevent the movement for university creation. Considering the University's founding as a victory of progressive forces within such turmoil, the distinguished political leader demonstrated that this important event was the culmination of struggles waged by Azerbaijan's best sons for centuries to enlighten their native people and open the doors of world culture and science knowledge to them.
en.idx.0269: In his speech, Heydar Aliyev explained how the University transformed into an advanced center of science and culture, an institution preparing highly qualified cadres, and how the best traditions of Azerbaijan's bright and distinctive culture developed at the University as follows: 'The names of the famous philosopher A. Bahmanyar and thinker poet Nizami, mathematician-astronomer Nasir al-Din al-Tusi and great lyric poet Fuzuli, great medieval scholar F. Rashidaddin and rebellious poet Nesimi, historian Bakikhanov and realist writer M.F. Akhundov, and prominent satirists from Alakbar Sabir, Jalil Mammadguluzade and many others adorn the treasury of this culture's centuries-long history. We are grateful to the Azerbaijani people's many prominent sons for preserving like the apple of their eye the torch of our people's social thought, science and culture in circumstances of dark obscurantism and lawlessness. Today, concluding with the Azerbaijan State University's half-century journey, we can rightfully say that the anniversary fully deserves this high title by proving it through all its activities.' In the conclusion of his speech, Heydar Aliyev set great tasks before the University collective, expressing his confidence that it would justify this confidence, the vast collective would remain true to the beautiful traditions of the university, the flagship of the republic's institutions of higher learning, and would honorably fulfill the great and responsible tasks ahead.
en.idx.0270: Speaking in the native language before hundreds of foreign guests and high-ranking officials from other republics of the USSR at such an international event, Heydar Aliyev restored the national spirit within the University's walls. By boldly breaking existing prohibitions, Heydar Aliyev demonstrated not only his dedication to and love for the native language through his speech, but also, by calling for special attention to national history, established a new direction of development for the entire Azerbaijani society. This direction caused great resonance in a society distancing itself from national enthusiasm.
en.idx.0271: As a result of properly developing education and science and achieving success in training highly qualified personnel in science and culture sectors, on February 11, 1971, the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR awarded Azerbaijan State University the Order of the Red Banner of Labor in commemoration of its 50th anniversary.
en.idx.0272: Such festive celebrations were held in subsequent years as well. In 1980, the Bureau of the Communist Party of Azerbaijan decided on celebrating ADU's 60th jubilee. Accordingly, jubilee events began from the beginning of 1980. On March 13, 1980, the University was honored with an Honorary Decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of Azerbaijan SSR for its services in the development of science and training of highly qualified specialists and in connection with its 60th anniversary. On that day, a scientific session dedicated to the 60th jubilee was held at the University. On March 14, five University staff members were awarded the honorary title of Honored Scholar, two - Honored Cultural Worker, two - Honored Lawyer, and one - Honored Geologist. Ten of the University's staff were honored with an Honorary Decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of Azerbaijan SSR. In connection with the jubilee and the presentation of high awards, a solemn event was held at the F.E. Dzerzhinsky Club on March 14. The Chairman of the Council of Ministers of Azerbaijan SSR A. Ibrahimov congratulated the University's faculty and students on this event on behalf of the Communist Party of Azerbaijan, the Presidium of the republic's Supreme Soviet and the Council of Ministers. Representatives of institutions of higher learning from various republics and cities of the USSR also participated in the jubilee event.
en.idx.0273: In the Soviet period, there was an organic connection between events occurring in the republic and the University's life. The world-renowned distinguished politician and statesman Heydar Aliyev, highly evaluating the University's role in the processes occurring in the 20th century and in the formation of the national liberation movement, stated: 'At Baku State University's lecture halls, classrooms, and departments, much work has been done to develop the Azerbaijani people's identity, national consciousness, and national spirit. I particularly note this today. Because a scholar and teacher developing their own language, a scholar writing about and developing their own history and reflecting it, a scholar studying, analyzing and generalizing their people's spirituality and disseminating it at a high level to the people - all together they serve the development and progress of their people's, nation's, national consciousness, national spirit, and patriotic spirit. The emergence, development, and expansion of the national liberation movement in Azerbaijan, protection of the pages of our history from distortion and falsification, the fact that our people possess a great history and great culture from generation to generation, and possess great spirituality - all of this resulted from the activities of our scholars, teachers, and those working in institutions of higher learning in the 20th century. Azerbaijan State University's services in this sphere are very significant, and I consider it necessary to particularly note this today.' The University was always the main center in the formation of the Azerbaijani people's intellectual potential throughout all periods. Its employees have rendered great services to the development of all sectors of Azerbaijani society. University scholars have made invaluable contributions to Azerbaijani science.
en.idx.0274: Approaching the admission process at the University carefully, Heydar Aliyev, the First Secretary of the Communist Party of Azerbaijan, personally participated in ensuring the objectivity of the university entrance examinations held at the University in the 1970s. The reforms he initiated in the 1970s to admit workers' and peasants' children to the Faculty of Law caused great resonance throughout the former Soviet Union, and his interview titled 'Let Justice Triumph' given to one of Moscow's central newspapers 'Literaturnaya Gazeta' was translated into all national languages and widely disseminated. This experience was later applied in other republics as well.
en.idx.0275: Thus, after world-renowned statesman and political figure National Leader Heydar Aliyev was elected as Azerbaijan's political leader in 1969, a process of rise began in the republic's life. National Leader Heydar Aliyev approached the University, a temple of science, education, and culture, with special care. The measures taken had a positive impact on the activities of Azerbaijan State University, the flagship of institutions of higher learning in Azerbaijan, and a period of renaissance began in the University's life. This period lasted until the late 1980s.
en.idx.0276: Although the state regained independence in 1991, confronted with acute political and economic crisis, Azerbaijan faced the threat of losing independence at any moment. The ongoing political processes had a negative impact on the entire republic's life, including the University's. While the country's restoration of state independence created the basis for the University's activities to rise to a new qualitative level, this rise only occurred after the National Leader Heydar Aliyev returned to leading the country at the insistent demand of the people in June 1993. With Heydar Aliyev's return to leading the republic, Azerbaijan was saved from disaster and chaos, disintegration and destruction, and civil war. Political stability was established in the country and BSU began gradually restoring its previous prestige. The distinguished statesman Heydar Aliyev, even in such difficult circumstances, thought about BSU and its future, and highly valued the University's role in strengthening the independent state.
en.idx.0277: Heydar Aliyev repeatedly visited the University and gave it new life. Before his return to power, BSU was in a very deplorable state. In Azerbaijan's first institution of higher learning, the level of teaching had declined, hope for the future weakened in the collective, and not only the University but other institutions of higher learning in the republic faced the threat of collapse. Many scholars left Azerbaijan for other countries, and some ceased their pedagogical and scientific activities.
en.idx.0278: Heydar Aliyev's return to leading Azerbaijan awakened hope and confidence in the future in all workers of science and education, including the BSU collective. In 1992, 91 public and science figures, including BSU intellectuals, appealed to Heydar Aliyev asking him to return to great politics - to the leadership of the republic. This appeal became a historic event, written into the republic's political history as one of the turning points. Heydar Aliyev's response letter to the '91ers' is considered one of the pearls of the National Leader's political legacy. In his appeal, declaring that he would not remain indifferent to the Azerbaijani people's fate, the National Leader fulfilled the promise given to the people, saving the country from the threat of destruction.
en.idx.0279: As a result of the President's attention and care, the University emerged from crisis. Following the distinguished statesman's return to power, the strategic line implemented in the education sphere created conditions for conducting fundamental reforms at BSU like other educational institutions and ensured its future development. From 1993, significant progress was felt in teaching activities and scientific research work, measures were taken to strengthen the material and technical base. The funding allocated to the University and student admissions were increased annually. Significant reforms were carried out in the educational process, educational discipline was strengthened. Through Heydar Aliyev's care, new faculties and specialties were opened. With expanding international relations, BSU, as the leading institution of higher education of the independent state, gained the opportunity to establish direct relations with the world's leading institutions of higher learning.
en.idx.0280: On September 3, 1994, President Heydar Aliyev of Azerbaijan signed a decree on celebrating the University's 75th jubilee, and a Jubilee Commission was established accordingly. Although political stability had not yet been fully restored in the country and the economic situation was difficult, Heydar Aliyev's personal leadership of the commission was a manifestation of the state leader's high value and attention to the University's role and significance in society's life, and his concern for science, education, and culture.
en.idx.0281: In accordance with the President's decree, the University's 75th jubilee was celebrated in a solemn manner on November 26 of that year at the Republic Palace (present-day Heydar Aliyev Palace). President Heydar Aliyev also participated in the jubilee ceremony. In his speech at the ceremony, evaluating the establishment of BSU as a remarkable event, Heydar Aliyev called BSU 'the national wealth, national pride of the Azerbaijani people and Azerbaijan Republic' and said: '...When we talk about Baku State University, we think of Azerbaijan's science, education, culture, and the enlightenment of our entire people.' Giving special value to the development of Azerbaijani science and directing attention to the University's role in this process, the National Leader said in his speech: 'Azerbaijani science is among the world's advanced sciences. Azerbaijan State University's activities are invaluable in its development. From the day of its establishment, Baku State University transformed into a center promoting scientific development in Azerbaijan. In subsequent periods, the majority of scientific research institutes established in Azerbaijan, all centers of science, trace their origins to Baku State University.'
en.idx.0282: Because of the University's concern for the development of science and education, raising its name and prestige to great heights, and its invaluable service before the Azerbaijani people and state, by the decision of BSU's Academic Council dated October 28, 1994, President of Azerbaijan Republic Heydar Aliyev was deemed worthy of the Honorary Doctor title of Baku State University.
en.idx.0283: In his congratulatory letter to the University collective in 1999 on the occasion of BSU's 80th anniversary, President Heydar Aliyev of Azerbaijan wrote: 'Many patriotic intellectuals who worked with great determination for the progress, development, and flourishing of Azerbaijan are alumni of this national educational institution. Throughout its 80-year history, the University has produced prominent figures for science, culture, and literature of our republic...'
en.idx.0284: It is noteworthy that throughout all periods of its activities, BSU, while being a temple of science and education, also played the role of a center that served in the development of the Azerbaijani language, the development of national consciousness and patriotic spirit. While continually highly appreciating the efforts of those who laid the foundation of BSU and those who contributed to its development, I respectfully remember them with great gratitude and respect.' These thoughts of great historical significance both express respect for the memory of those who built the University and represent high appreciation of the role BSU played in the national and spiritual development of the Azerbaijani people.
en.idx.0285: On February 11, 2000, President Heydar Aliyev met with foreign guests who had come to participate in the jubilee events and a group of University staff at his residence. By the decree signed on February 11, 2000, by the President on the occasion of BSU's 80th anniversary, 17 University teachers were awarded the 'Honor' order, 18 received the 'Progress' medal, 13 were awarded the honorary title of Honored Scholar, and 21 - Honored Teacher. This was the first time so many intellectuals of the University were honored with such awards. This award was a result of the distinguished statesman Heydar Aliyev's concern not only for the University collective but for all Azerbaijani science and education.
en.idx.0286: BSU has always felt the concern of its world-renowned alumnus. Precisely because of the distinguished statesman Heydar Aliyev's attention and concern, the University achieved new development and progress, comprehensive expansion and improvement of its activities became possible. The University has achieved great success in education, the development of science, and strengthening of material and technical base.
en.idx.0287: The BSU collective, like all Azerbaijanis, warmly welcomed the decree of Azerbaijan Republic President declaring 2023 as 'Heydar Aliyev Year,' and with the words 'I am very happy to be a graduate of Baku State University,' with which he elevated his name and prestige to great heights, and called it a national treasure and national pride of our people and state, has prepared and implemented an Events Plan related to the 100th jubilee of the National Leader at BSU. In accordance with the Events Plan, more than 200 events were held at the international and republic levels - international and republic-level scientific-theoretical and scientific-practical conferences, forums, symposiums, seminars, special lectures, master classes, essay, drawing, and artistic recitation competitions, book and drawing exhibitions, knowledge and sports competitions, various tournaments, charitable events and tree-planting activities, joint events with regional executive authorities in regions, excursions to museums, lectures at secondary schools, and books were published.
en.idx.0288: Every scholar, researcher, and teacher working at this venerable educational institution, and every student possessing scientific knowledge, considers studying and disseminating the rich and inexhaustible legacy of immortal Heydar Aliyev as one of their highest purposes at all times. They prepare new works, books, and articles dedicated to studying the rich legacy of the National Leader and the Azerbaijanism idea, making greater efforts for comprehensive study and dissemination of this rich legacy. BSU's faculty and students honor themselves by serving our science and education with the attention and care of our esteemed President Ilham Aliyev and our First Vice-President Mrs. Mehriban Aliyeva, making efforts to further strengthen statehood in our country and brilliantly implement the National Leader Heydar Aliyev's development doctrine.
en.idx.0290: Baku State University fulfills its responsibilities with dignity in preparing highly qualified national cadres, forming new scientific directions, integrating into the world education space, and creating cultural and spiritual values. The University today, through its numerous graduates working in various fields of state administration, economy, science, education, and culture, continues to contribute to independent Azerbaijan's development.
en.idx.0291:
Ilham Aliyev
President of the Republic of Azerbaijan
en.idx.0293: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan
en.idx.0295: Ilham Aliyev, who won a brilliant victory in the presidential elections of 2003 and was elected President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, successfully continues the democratic, legal, and secular state-building policy of our people's great son, Heydar Aliyev, and successfully implements the course of preserving and developing the national and spiritual values of the Azerbaijani people.
en.idx.0296: Baku State University (BSU), established during the period of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, holds unique significance among the national and spiritual values and treasures the Azerbaijani people have acquired throughout their history. President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev, highly appreciating the University's historical service before our people, has signed the Decree 'On Celebration of the 100th Anniversary of Baku State University.' The decree, which bears great historical significance, states: 'Baku State University, a legacy of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, has traveled a glorious path full of achievements since its establishment as the first new-type institution of higher learning in the Muslim East. Always demonstrating loyalty to the idea of Azerbaijanism, the University has commendable services in establishing a system of higher education in the country, conducting scientific research in depth with the application of the latest technologies to modern standards, and accelerating the process of national self-awareness in general. Baku State University, through its prominent social-political, science and culture figures trained by devoted intellectuals throughout its history, has made significant contributions to shaping Azerbaijan's present image. The formation of creative scientific thinking based on innovative ideas in the country, continuous improvement of trained cadre potential and scientific-intellectual environment, including the preservation and development of Azerbaijani people's historical-cultural values and moral-ethical wealth, constitute the main directions of the University's current diverse and extensive activities by choosing integration into the world education space.'
en.idx.0297: In achieving the successes mentioned in the Decree concerning BSU, along with National Leader Heydar Aliyev, President Ilham Aliyev's attention and care have played a significant role. He has shown special attention and care to ensuring the continuous development of the Azerbaijani people and state's future, the advancement of science and education, including BSU, and its transformation into the most advanced center of science and higher education.
en.idx.0298: Inspired by this, the University collective began organizing its activities in accordance with the new era's demands. Along with restructuring teaching, implementing changes and reforms in administrative structure, significant work has been done to raise science and education to the world standards level and ensure integration, and new specialties, departments, laboratories, science and teaching centers, etc. have begun operations.
en.idx.0299: In the 2008 January 31-dated Decree of President Ilham Aliyev 'On Certain Measures Regarding the Integration of Azerbaijan's Institutions of Higher Education into the European Higher Education Space,' it is envisaged to accelerate work on the process of integrating education in Azerbaijan into the world education system, particularly the integration of higher education institutions into the European higher education space, and the implementation of the requirements of the Bologna Declaration. The creation of a unified credit system in the European education space, mutual recognition of higher education documents and specialties, provision of student mobility, integration into European universities, improvement of the quality of education and knowledge and meeting the growing global demands for it are important objectives that are currently being pursued in the University at all three levels of higher education - undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degree programs adapted to the European Credit Transfer System.
en.idx.0300: In order to further raise the level of student training and bring it in line with international standards, a decision was made to teach foreign languages in courses I-III at all faculties, and new educational technology-based cabinets were put into use, considering the great importance of teaching foreign languages, particularly English, German, and French. To accelerate the process of integration into the European higher education space, mutual recognition of higher education documents and specialties, and to improve the quality of education and student academic development in accordance with Bologna Declaration requirements, English-speaking groups were created in faculties. Due to the expansion of teaching in foreign languages, as a result of the increase in the number of foreign country citizens studying at the University, and in contrast to previous years, their desire to study in Azerbaijan, the quality of Azerbaijani language teaching has improved. During this process, on May 23, 2012, President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan issued a Decree 'On the Use of Azerbaijani Language in the Context of Globalization in Accordance with Modern Requirements and the Development of Linguistics in the Country,' and the State Program adopted on April 9, 2013, based on this Decree, was used as the basis.
en.idx.0301: Since the last educational building was put into use in 1988, the opening of new faculties, departments, laboratories, scientific research institutes at BSU during the subsequent period, and the increase in the number of students created certain problems in organizing the educational process. A devoted supporter of science and education, President Ilham Aliyev of the Republic of Azerbaijan, closely followed the construction process of BSU's new building, and thanks to funds allocated for construction work by his special instruction, it became possible to complete the building in a short time.
en.idx.0302: One of the significant achievements in improving the teaching and scientific activity conditions and strengthening the material and technical base of the collective on the eve of BSU's 90th jubilee was the opening of a new educational building on September 15, 2008. President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic participated in the opening ceremony and delivered an extensive speech. In his speech, the President drew special attention to the University's role in the country's science and education, highly appreciated the faculty's efforts, spoke about the tasks ahead, and put forward strategic goals such as further improving the quality of education, expanding relations with foreign countries, learning and applying new experience, and sending Azerbaijani youth to advanced universities for education.
en.idx.0303: In accordance with President Ilham Aliyev's decree dated April 24, 2009, BSU's 90th jubilee was celebrated with great pomp. At the jubilee ceremony held on November 2, President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic participated and delivered a congratulatory speech. Appreciating the University's historical mission before our people, the President stated: 'Baku State University has a very beautiful and great history. Founded in 1919, the University has played a very important role in comprehensive development of Azerbaijan over its 90 years. Baku State University was established by the parliament of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic a year after Azerbaijan gained independence. This was a very thoughtful and far-sighted step. At that time, our country was very young. Nevertheless, the establishment of the University for the enlightenment of the population, elimination of illiteracy in Azerbaijan, and strengthening of intellectual potential was a very important event. As you know, the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic lived for two years, its life was not long, it fell two years later. But Baku State University survived. Of course, it operated within the ideological framework of those times. But despite this, Baku State University played a very important role in Azerbaijan's development, the development of education in Azerbaijan, and strengthening of scientific potential. This role continues today. It is very gratifying that Baku State University has been able to maintain its leading role in the education sphere of Azerbaijan throughout these years, and today this role is strengthening further. This once again shows that the University has very rich traditions, great potential, experienced faculty, and students' dedication to studies and education. Especially in today's conditions, everything is measured by the level of education. Everyone's future, every young person's fate depends on their knowledge, experience, and literacy... Baku State University has made valuable contributions throughout various periods to comprehensive development of Azerbaijan. Baku State University graduates have made valuable contributions to our country's flourishing through their activities.'
en.idx.0304: President Ilham Aliyev's speech precisely defined the main strategy for future development of science and education in Azerbaijan in general and at BSU in particular, its purposes, essence and methods of implementation, and disclosed its perspectives. At the jubilee ceremony, President Ilham Aliyev was awarded the Honorary Doctor diploma of Baku State University.
en.idx.0305: In accordance with the Decree of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan on the occasion of BSU's 90th jubilee and for its services in the development of education and science in Azerbaijan, 107 University staff members were honored with honorary titles. Of these, 7 people received the Presidential personal stipend of Azerbaijan Republic President, 9 - Honored Scholar, 32 - Honored Teacher, 2 - Honored Lawyer, 1 - Honored Journalist, 1 - Honored Engineer, 1 - Honored Culture Worker titles, 1 person was awarded the 'Honor' order, 1 - 'Independence' order, 14 - 'Glory' order, and 38 - 'Progress' medal.
en.idx.0306: The University collective actively participates in the successful implementation of the science and education policy of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic. The country's President Ilham Aliyev, having repeatedly noted the importance of the non-oil sector and human capital development, set important tasks before scientists. The University's faculty, guided precisely by this strategy, makes great efforts to strengthen the country's science and education potential and prepare highly qualified, educated, and patriotic cadres for the country.
en.idx.0307: The BSU collective has identified its responsibilities related to the implementation of measures envisaged by State Programs for educational institutions.
en.idx.0308: For this purpose, BSU's Strategic Development Plan has been prepared. The document clarifies the essence of the strategy to be implemented in the current phase, international experience and trends in education, the main tasks of the education system in Azerbaijan Republic, the strategy's purposes, directions, strategic goals and measures, and the main conditions for its successful implementation. In the plan, the University's mission is defined as training highly qualified pedagogical, engineering-technical, and scientific specialists who possess fundamental knowledge in multi-disciplinary, continuous education and scientific research in accordance with world standards, innovative research skills, are competitive in the international and national labor market, and are raised in the spirit of patriotism.
en.idx.0309: One of the issues envisaged in State Programs is preparation of a new generation of specialists using the most advanced scientific achievements and innovative teaching technologies in the country, modernization of content and quality indicators of Azerbaijan's higher education system through international dual diploma programs. Supporting the development of institutions of higher education by learning and applying international experience is an important priority. In this regard, ensuring the implementation of international dual diploma programs at BSU is of special importance, because the teaching of specialties in accordance with the country's development priorities is adapted to the teaching programs of the world's leading institutions of higher education, significant work is being conducted on the basis of signed agreements.
en.idx.0310: Important steps are being taken to integrate University scholars' research into world science and bring Azerbaijan science to the international arena. Taking into account BSU's experience in international cooperation and foreign relations, in order to establish and develop international cooperation in science and education, numerous measures have been taken to invite renowned foreign scholars and science and education figures to deliver lectures, expand business relations, and increase the mobility of teachers, doctoral candidates, graduate students, and students. The State Program has been adopted for the education of Azerbaijani youth in foreign countries to form high-intelligence human capital, support youth education abroad, and bring advanced science and education environment from abroad to Azerbaijan.
en.idx.0311: As a result of efforts directed towards such successful activities, significant results are achieved today in international integration processes, education and science. An important event in the evaluation of scientific research conducted at BSU and involving youth in science was the establishment by President Ilham Aliyev's decree in 2016 of the 'Presidential Prize for Youth.' BSU's young scholars regularly receive this award. By the August 6, 2013 Decree of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic, the 'Young Talents' Lyceum became one of the winners of the 'Best Secondary School' competition held in the 2012-2013 academic year.
en.idx.0312: On September 18, 2013, the opening ceremony of the newly constructed building of BSU's Quba Teaching-Practice and Recreation Center took place, with President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic and President of Heydar Aliyev Foundation Mrs. Mehriban Aliyeva participating. All necessary conditions have been created for 400 people to rest at the center. Rooms designed for both faculty and students meet the highest modern standards. The center's 8-hectare territory also contains 2 stadiums (designed for football, volleyball, and tennis), a central boiler house and water tank, parks and green areas.
en.idx.0313: Thanks to the special attention and care of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic, a number of significant events have taken place in BSU's life, in 2017 the University was granted the status of a public legal entity, reforms aimed at the country's development were implemented, important steps were taken to strengthen the potential of faculty and students and organize material and technical support in accordance with modern requirements.
en.idx.0314: As a result of public attention to Azerbaijan's first university, its jubilees have always been celebrated as celebrations of education and science. In this regard, the celebration of the University's 100th jubilee has special significance. In accordance with the November 14, 2017 Decree of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic 'On Celebration of the 100th Anniversary of Baku State University,' the May 21, 2018 Decision of the Cabinet of Ministers of Azerbaijan Republic approved the Events Plan dedicated to the jubilee. In accordance with the Events Plan, a series of events were held at both the country and international levels. The 'Baku State University's 100th Anniversary (1919-2019)' jubilee medal was established, and the silver jubilee monetary sign with a nominal value of 5 manat issued by the Central Bank was put into circulation to commemorate the jubilee date. BSU's Jubilee stamp was produced and books were published on the occasion of BSU's 100th anniversary.
en.idx.0315: At the jubilee ceremony held on November 26, 2019, President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic participated and congratulated the entire Azerbaijani people on the occasion of BSU's 100th anniversary. The President delivered a programmatic speech before the faculty, students, and guests. The country's leader, discussing BSU's special role in our people's fate, particularly emphasized that the University has made great contributions to the comprehensive development of the country over its 100 years. Recalling that BSU was established by the decision of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, President Ilham Aliyev noted that after the fall of the ADR, the University continued its activities with honor in the new socio-political system. Over 100 years, the University had approximately 200,000 graduates who demonstrated their knowledge and skills in various fields of Azerbaijan, and prominent figures, scientists, social figures, politicians, and specialists emerged from among the University's graduates. The country's President emphasized that Azerbaijani people's National Leader, founder of the modern Azerbaijani state Heydar Aliyev was also an alumnus of BSU, and that the National Leader rendered invaluable service before the people and state in both Soviet and independence periods.
en.idx.0316: President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic, always keeping the need for education development in the focus of attention, offered youth his recommendations regarding the future, stating: '... A diploma is nothing, know that. If there is no knowledge, if there is no education, in the modern world, it is an insignificant thing. There must be knowledge. Because now new professions are opening. Many of the old professions are disappearing. Already some professions that existed 20 years ago no longer exist and will not exist. This process will continue, we are in the midst of the fourth industrial revolution. It is already known which professions will not exist in 5 years. But we are a country with a growing population. From 7 million in the Soviet period, our population has reached 10 million. That is why we must learn those new professions. We must create opportunities for our citizens to master those professions. Therefore, in this field, both teachers have a big task and students must always strive. Knowledge and education - that is what determines their good future, secure future. They must be patriots. Without this, our country will have no future. Without this, someday we will again fall under someone's influence and live again with hopes for independence. Therefore, patriotism must be very strong in youth. Young people must be educated in the spirit of national spirit, patriotism, and traditional values. Such young people will lead our country to the future with confidence. I believe that the vast majority of today's youth meets these criteria - knowledgeable, educated, devoted to the Homeland, patriotic and open to the world. It should be so that Azerbaijan's state independence is strengthened.
en.idx.0317: Independence would have been lost in 1993 as well if Heydar Aliyev had not returned. He protected independence, preserved it, strengthened it, and put us on the right path. We also follow his path, we strengthen and will strengthen independence.
en.idx.0318: Our independence is our main task. Azerbaijan is an independent state, a proud state, and a state that looks to the future with great optimism. Once again I congratulate you, wish you good health and success."
en.idx.0319: To fulfill the tasks arising from President Ilham Aliyev's programmatic speech, an 'Events Plan on Implementation of Tasks Arising from the Speech of President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Republic at the Ceremony Held on the Occasion of the 100th Anniversary of Baku State University' was prepared and implemented at BSU.
en.idx.0320: In accordance with the relevant Decree of the President of Azerbaijan Republic, in honor of BSU's 100th anniversary and for its services in the development of education and science in Azerbaijan, BSU's staff members were honored with honorary titles. Of these, 4 people received the Presidential personal stipend of Azerbaijan Republic President, 6 - Honored Scholar, 23 - Honored Teacher, 6 - Honorary Diploma of Azerbaijan Republic President, 1 person was awarded the 'Honor' order, 11 - 'Glory' order, 2 - 2nd degree 'Labor' order, 24 - 3rd degree 'Labor' order, and 36 - 'Progress' medal.
en.idx.0321: All of this inspires the University's faculty to work with greater determination and dedication to contribute to the development of science and education in Azerbaijan. The President's participation and programmatic speech at the 100th jubilee ceremony set new goals before the University collective. BSU staff make efforts to achieve the goals ahead and justify the President's confidence at the highest level, preparing competitive and patriotic-spirited specialists for the international and national labor market.
en.idx.0322: In 2020, during the 44-day Patriotic War, under the leadership of President Ilham Aliyev, the Victorious Commander-in-Chief, the valor of our heroic Army, and the courage of the patriotic generation, our lands were liberated from enemy occupation. The glorious victory and historic triumph that concluded the Patriotic War and the one-day anti-terrorism measures of 2023 freed our occupied territories from captivity, restored our territorial integrity and sovereignty. Thus, our people's liberator, founder and builder of the independent Azerbaijani state, National Leader Heydar Aliyev's national liberation struggle that began on June 15, 1993, through the purposeful, consistent, and determined policy of our esteemed President, our Victorious Commander-in-Chief Ilham Aliyev, professional diplomatic moves, and skillful military leadership, reached its logical conclusion. Independent, powerful, sovereign Azerbaijan with complete territorial integrity entered a new chapter of life.
en.idx.0323: The restoration and reconstruction work being successfully carried out today in the liberated territories is a brilliant manifestation to the entire world of our state's strength, our people's wisdom, our state leader's determination, and our indomitable will. We confidently say that under the leadership of our esteemed President Ilham Aliyev, greater progress, continuous development, and more prosperous days await Azerbaijan!
en.idx.0324: During the 44-day Patriotic War that ended in historic victory, BSU's collective, our students, and graduates displayed dedication both on the front lines and on the home front. Many students and graduates of the University were sent to the front as volunteers, and 22 of them reached the summit of sacred martyrdom. At the same time, during the days of the Patriotic War, BSU's collective and students fought on the home front, particularly contributing to the information war. After the historic victory, the BSU collective continued its activities in this sphere, implementing a number of academic projects.
en.idx.0325: Currently, large-scale construction work is being carried out at an unprecedented pace in Karabakh and East Zangezur. Like all our people, the BSU collective works with greater determination and confidence in the future, inspired by these good news and our successive victories. Today - being a citizen of independent Azerbaijan that has restored territorial integrity and raised the tricolor flag in Karabakh - is a source of honor and infinite pride for each of us. The large collective of BSU and students, gaining strength from our country's current development and progress, walk toward the future with greater confidence.
en.idx.0326: The University, as always, continues its successes with the high attention and comprehensive support of the country's President Ilham Aliyev and the First Vice-President of Azerbaijan Republic Mrs. Mehriban Aliyeva. Administrative reforms meeting modern requirements are being carried out at the University, purposeful activities are being conducted for the institution of higher education and science with an honorable past and historic traditions to occupy leading positions in the list of modern world universities. Teaching is built on the basis of modern, innovative teaching technologies as a combination of historic traditions and modern world experience, content of scientific research work is updated in accordance with the times' demands, international academic relations and domestic cooperation are developed. In accordance with the state's youth rejuvenation policy, personnel reforms are conducted, talented and promising youth are promoted. Continuous practical steps are being taken to improve the social situation of University staff.
en.idx.0327: The victorious and powerful country's daily development, achievements in science and education, inspire infinite pride in the BSU faculty and students. With the attention and care of our esteemed President, BSU, developing its rich traditions and benefiting from international experience and world science achievements, continues its mission of preparing cadres who are based on scientific foundations, national and cultural values, and meet the demands of the modern era for the Azerbaijani people and international society.

en.idx.0499: Baku State University's 'Eco Space' provided within the COP29 framework is a unique education and research platform contributing to Azerbaijan's 'green growth' strategy. Located on 1000 square meters, this innovative space combines aquaponic systems, microalgae bioreactors, solar panels, and digital air quality monitoring with modern ecological technologies.
en.idx.0500: The space enables students, researchers, and the general public to practically learn the concepts of 'green energy,' 'green food,' and 'green atmosphere.' Water conservation with fish and plant cultivation, oxygen production through photosynthesis, and application of renewable energy technologies are demonstrated here in real-time.
en.idx.0501: 'Eco Space' provides an ideal environment for ecological education, scientific research, and incubation of innovative projects in accordance with the UN's Sustainable Development Goals. Green areas enriched with rare plant species serve biodiversity conservation and provide rich resources for research.
